## Safety and release checklist

- [ ] I used only synthetic or privacy-minimized fixtures and included no learner data, private source material, credentials, or release keys.
- [ ] I preserved Active Atom/Paper, prerequisite, Evidence, skip/mastery, review, and approval invariants relevant to this change.
- [ ] I updated schemas, templates, references, and the capability ledger when a public contract or delivery claim changed.
- [ ] I updated English and Chinese README sections together when applicable.
- [ ] I did not describe engineering tests, model compatibility, or telemetry as a proven learning effect.
- [ ] I ran the smallest relevant tests and the applicable fast/integration suite.
